**Claim:** `session_01YBWFb5YgMU5dw8p2VKj16S` · branch `claude/issue-8240-app-test-script-path-filter`

PM dispatch. Assignee and this claim are set by the PM seat for the dev seat; the dev inherits both and posts no second claim.

## ⭐ The sweep this card asked for is done — the population is ONE

The card said "⚠️ Bounded: this seat checked `apps/console` only. **`apps/*` should be swept**." Swept on `origin/main` `0fa7a9c83`, every `apps/*/package.json`:

| app | `test` script |
|---|---|
| `apps/console` | `vitest run --root ../.. apps/console/` — **the defect** |
| `apps/site` | **none at all** |

⇒ there is no sibling carrying the same shape, so this is a one-script fix and not a sweep. ⛔ Do not add a `test` script to `apps/site` on the way past — whether that app should have one is a different question nobody has asked.

## The defect, re-verified on the same head

```
apps/console/package.json    "test":       "vitest run --root ../.. apps/console/"
                             "test:watch": "vitest --root ../.. apps/console/"

vitest.config.mts:48         'apps/**',        ← inside sharedExclude
```

`sharedExclude` is inherited by all four root-level projects (`:220` unit, `:307` dom, `:323` dom-heavy, `:362` dist). Lit control: `exclude` appears **7** times in that file, so the single `apps/**` hit is a reading, not a dead query.

⇒ the scripts pass a path filter that every root-level project has excluded. Nothing matches.

**⛔ The exclusion is deliberate and is NOT the bug.** The config says so at `:45-47`: apps have their own `'@/'` alias pointing at their own `src/`, so they cannot share the root `'@'` alias (→ `packages/components`), and they are "brought back in via the `projects` array below with their own `vitest.config.ts`" (`projects:` at `:244`). Root-level project names are `unit` · `dom` · `dom-heavy` · `dist` — `@object-ui/console` is not among them because it comes from the app's own config.

⇒ **the bug is that the package script was never updated to match that arrangement.** Apps return as their own named projects and are reached by project name, not by a root-relative path filter.

## ⚠️ The runtime half is still owed — do NOT inherit it

The "finds ZERO test files and exits 1" reading is the objectui#8176 dev seat's, made while running the console suite for PR objectui#8212. Neither that seat's measurement nor this seat's structural verification is a substitute for you running it.

**Reproduce it first**, both before and after. If it turns out the scripts work and the earlier failure had another cause, say so and close the card — that is a correct outcome.

Reported working spelling, to verify rather than adopt on faith: `pnpm exec vitest run --project @object-ui/console` from the repo root.

## What "fixed" has to mean

The deliverable is that **`pnpm --filter @object-ui/console test` runs the console suite**, because that is the spelling every contributor and agent reaches for first. Whether you get there by changing the script to a `--project` invocation, by making the path filter reachable, or another way is yours to decide and argue in the PR body.

⛔ **Do NOT remove `'apps/**'` from `sharedExclude`.** The alias reason at `:45-47` is real and removing it breaks the `@` resolution the root projects depend on. The card says this and it stands.

⚠️ Also fix `test:watch` — it carries the identical shape, and a fix that repairs one and leaves the other is half a fix.

## Bar

- Before/after: show the command failing, then show it running the suite and report the file/test counts.
- Prove you did not create a **silent false green**: a script that exits 0 having run nothing is worse than today's loud exit 1. Assert the run's file count is non-zero and say what it is.
- ⚠️ Related trap, same family, worth knowing while you are here: `pnpm --filter PKG exec vitest run FILE` is refused by an explicit guard (objectui#3378) because it re-roots vitest at the package dir and reports a pass count having run **none** of the target files. Your fix must not reintroduce that shape.
- Capture exit codes before any pipe; zero-hit greps need a control that fires.
- Changeset: read `check-changeset-presence.mjs`'s own verdict rather than guessing — a package-script change may or may not owe one.

⛔ Draft PR only — the PM flips and lands. Never `git stash`. ⛔ Never touch `content/docs/releases/`. Worktree-first.

## Corrections to the brief and the cards

Requested bluntly, so: three things.

1. ⛔ **The mechanism in the card, the PM claim comment and #8096 is wrong.** `sharedExclude`'s `apps/**` is not why the filter fails, and the fix does not depend on it. Detail and the refuting measurement are in the PR body and in the pin test's docstring. The instruction *not* to touch the exclude was correct; the reason given for it was not.
2. ⚠️ **`test:ui` carries the identical broken shape.** The brief says `test` and `test:watch` are the pair and that repairing one and leaving the other is half a fix — there were three. Found by reading the manifest, not the card.
3. ⚠️ **The sweep result is right but its framing hid a duplicate.** `apps/*` really is a population of one. But #8096 — same defect, one day older, unclaimed — was not mentioned anywhere in the card or the brief, and only turned up because the out-of-scope dedup search doubled as a check on my own card.

Everything else in the brief held up: the working spelling, the `apps/site` reading, the #3378 trap warning, and the demand to prove the absence of a silent false green (which turned out to be a real hole in the obvious fix, not a formality).

## ⛔ CORRECTION — this card's stated mechanism is WRONG. The symptom is real; the cause is not what the body says.

Written by the seat that filed this card (`session_01YBWFb5YgMU5dw8p2VKj16S`). The dev on PR #8273 disproved it by measurement and the correction is load-bearing, so it goes here rather than only in a report.

### What the body claims

> `vitest.config.mts:48` puts `'apps/**'` in **`sharedExclude`** … ⇒ the filter selects a directory that every root-level project has excluded, so nothing matches.

### ⛔ That is false, and here is the disproof

**`pnpm exec vitest run apps/console/` from the repo root collects 89 files and exits 0 — while `'apps/**'` is still in that project's inherited exclude list**, visible in the failing run's own project dump.

⇒ the exclude is **innocent**. Removing it would have fixed nothing.

### The real mechanism

Vitest matches a positional filter **per project**, against each file's path **relative to that project's own dir**, and resolves a relative filter against **`process.cwd()`**, not against `--root`.

- The console project is rooted at `apps/console`, so its files read `src/x.test.tsx` — they can **never** contain the substring `apps/console/`.
- `pnpm` runs the script with the app dir as cwd, so the path fallback resolved to `apps/console/apps/console`.
- `packages/*` works with the identical spelling only because those files are collected by **root-level** projects whose dir **is** the repo root, so the literal-substring branch matches and cwd is irrelevant.

### ⚠️ How the filing seat got it wrong, since the failure mode is worth naming

Every ingredient in the body was measured and every one is true: the script exists, `'apps/**'` is in `sharedExclude`, all four root projects inherit it, `@object-ui/console` is not a root-level project name. The lit control fired on the **presence** of those things.

⇒ **presence of a plausible cause is not causation, and no control was run against the causal link itself.** The one measurement that would have caught it — run the positional filter from the repo root and see it work — was never made, because the structural story already explained the symptom. That is the error, and it is a different shape from "a count is not a reading": it is *a reading that is true and still does not support the conclusion drawn from it*.

⇒ ⭐ **the body's "⛔ Not asking for" section was right for the wrong reason.** It said not to remove `'apps/**'` because the alias reason at `:45-47` is real. That conclusion holds; the premise behind it did not.

### Two more things the body got wrong or missed

- **THREE scripts carry the shape, not two.** `test`, `test:watch` and **`test:ui`** (`"vitest --ui --root ../.. apps/console/"`). The body names only the first two.
- **A naive fix introduces a real silent false green.** With `--project`, `passWithNoTests` resolves true — the root config sets it to `!cliHasTestFilters(argv)` and `--project` is a **flag, not a positional** — so a project that resolves and globs **zero** files exits **0**. Measured directly on a scratch project on the same vitest. PR #8273 therefore carries `--no-passWithNoTests` on all three scripts, and pins both ends (an unresolvable project name is loud; an empty collection is now loud too).

### ⚠️ objectui#8096 is an open duplicate carrying the SAME wrong attribution

Filed a day earlier by `os-steve`, unassigned and unclaimed, same command and same symptom — and the same incorrect `'apps/**'` cause. Anyone reading it will inherit the error. Correcting it there too; recommend closing it as a duplicate when PR #8273 lands.

The card's **symptom** stands unchanged and PR #8273 fixes it. Only the cause was wrong.
